title: Energy-Guided Generative Modeling for Low-Energy Molecular Structure Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2512.22597v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Exploring molecular energy landscapes and identifying ground-state conformations are central challenges in computational chemistry. However, generating diverse low-energy conformers from molecular graphs remains expensive with traditional physics-based pipelines. Existing learning-based approaches remain fragmented: generative models capture conformational diversity but often lack reliable energy calibration, whereas deterministic predictors focus on a single structure and fail to represent ensemble variability. Here we introduce EnFlow, to our knowledge, the first energy-guided generative framework that couples flow-based conformer generation with explicit energy landscape modeling for joint conformational ensemble generation and ground-state identification. translated_title: 面向低能分子结构发现的能量引导生成建模
translated_abstract: 探索分子能量势面并识别基态构象是计算化学中的核心挑战。然而，利用传统的基于物理的流程从分子图中生成多样的低能构象依然代价高昂。现有的基于学习的方法仍然碎片化：生成模型能够捕捉构象多样性，但往往缺乏可靠的能量校准；而确定性预测器只关注单一结构，无法表征构象系综的变异性。在此，我们提出 EnFlow——据我们所知，这是首个能量引导的生成框架，它将基于流的构象生成与显式的能量势面建模相结合，用于构象系综生成与基态识别的联合任务。通过将生成动力学与学习得到的能量模型相集成，EnFlow 将采样引导至构象势面的低能区域，从而提升结构保真度（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: EnFlow 是首个将基于流的构象生成与显式能量势面建模相结合的能量引导生成框架，能够联合实现低能构象系综的生成与分子基态结构的识别。
en_tdlr: EnFlow is the first energy-guided generative framework that couples flow-based conformer generation with explicit energy landscape modeling, jointly enabling low-energy conformational ensemble generation and ground-state molecular structure identification.
